said.q: The artwork represents a conversation through quick and confident strokes, the expression is very dynamic. Adolphe Albert ( 28 juin 1855 , Paris - 30 mars 1938 , Les Andelys) painter, decorator, a member of the Graphic Sketch Club and the Philadelphia Art Club, he was awarded an honorable mention at the Columbian Exposition in Chicago in 1894, also received an honorable mention in Paris in 1899.
